data.name: NetworkHeader
data.comment: EN: Network NOTE: Heading of the card holding ports and the multicast group.

data.name: ServicesHeader
data.comment: EN: Services NOTE: Heading of the card holding what DXKeeper should do with each logged QSO.

data.name: DiagnosticsHeader
data.comment: EN: Diagnostics NOTE: Heading of the card holding logging options.

data.name: GeneralHeader
data.comment: EN: General NOTE: Heading of the card holding settings that belong to the gateway itself rather than to what it talks to - currently just the interface language.

data.name: LogCopy
data.comment: EN: Copy NOTE: Button copying the visible operation log to the clipboard.

data.name: LogClear
data.comment: EN: Clear NOTE: Button clearing the on-screen operation log. Does not affect ErrorLog.txt.

data.name: LogCopyTip
data.comment: EN: Copy the operation log to the clipboard

data.name: LogClearTip
data.value: Vyprázdniť záznam na obrazovke. ErrorLog.txt nie je ovplyvnená.
data.comment: EN: Clear the on-screen log. ErrorLog.txt is not affected.

data.name: LogCopied
data.value: Záznam operácií skopírovaný do schránky {0} riadky.
data.comment: EN: Operation log copied to the clipboard — {0} lines. NOTE: {0} is a line count. Written without brackets on purpose: parenthesised text around a placeholder is where the machine pass loses a bracket, and the result renders as ")12 lines". See the note on brackets at the top of this file.

data.name: FailedQsoIndicator
data.comment: EN: Failed QSOs NOTE: Always-present link in the middle of the window footer. Quiet when nothing has failed, highlighted with a count when something has. Keep it SHORT - it sits between two groups of buttons.

data.name: FailedQsoIndicatorCount
data.comment: EN: Failed QSOs: {0} NOTE: Same link once QSOs have failed this run. {0} is a count. Keep it short. Written without brackets on purpose - as "Failed QSOs ({0})" the machine pass moved the bracket and returned "(){0})", which reads as "Failed QSOs ()2)". Punctuation wrapped tightly around a placeholder does not survive translation reliably.

data.name: FailedQsoNoneTip
data.value: Nie. QSOs tento beh zlyhal. Kliknite pre otvorenie priečinka, kde by boli uložené, v prípade, že skorší spustiť opustil súbor za.
data.comment: EN: No QSOs have failed this run. Click to open the folder where they would be saved, in case an earlier run left a file behind. NOTE: Tooltip when nothing has failed. The second half matters: a file from an earlier run is otherwise easy to miss.

data.name: UdpPortLabel
data.comment: EN: UDP listening port: NOTE: Label for the port N1MM broadcasts QSO data to. "UDP" is a protocol name - do not translate.

data.name: UdpPortTip
data.value: UDP prístav, ktorý N1MM Logger+ vysielanie QSO XML do (štandard 12060)
data.comment: EN: UDP port that N1MM Logger+ broadcasts QSO XML to (default 12060) NOTE: Tooltip. Keep "N1MM Logger+", "UDP", "QSO" and "XML" in English.

data.name: MulticastLabel
data.comment: EN: Multicast group (optional): NOTE: Label for an optional IPv4 multicast group address.

data.name: MulticastPlaceholder
data.comment: EN: blank = no multicast NOTE: Placeholder shown inside the empty multicast text box.

data.name: MulticastTip
data.value: Nepovinné. Ponechajte prázdne, ak je vysielací program nakonfigurovaný tak, aby sa poslal do multicastovej skupiny (224.0.0 - 239.2555.255.255). Unicast a vysielanie sú prijaté tak či tak. Skupina je pripojená na rozhraní, ktoré vyberie smerovacia tabuľka.
data.comment: EN: Optional. Leave blank unless the sending program is configured to send to a multicast group (224.0.0.0 - 239.255.255.255). Unicast and broadcast are received either way. The group is joined on the interface the routing table selects. NOTE: Tooltip. Do not translate the address range.

data.name: DxKeeperPortLabel
data.comment: EN: DXKeeper TCP base port: NOTE: Label. "DXKeeper" and "TCP" - do not translate.

data.name: DxKeeperPortTip
data.value: Tu len na čítanie. Nastavte ho DXKeeper: {0}. Brána posiela do základného prístavu + 1, čo je prístav DXKeeper ukazuje v kurze toho panelu.
data.comment: EN: Read-only here. Set it in DXKeeper: {0}. The gateway sends to Base Port + 1, which is the port DXKeeper shows in that panel's heading. NOTE: Tooltip. {0} is the English menu path inside DXKeeper (DxKeeperConfigPath) and must stay untranslated, because DXKeeper's own interface is English-only.

data.name: DxKeeperConfigPath
data.value: Config > Defaults tab > Network Service > Base Port
data.comment: EN: Config > Defaults tab > Network Service > Base Port NOTE: DO NOT TRANSLATE. A literal menu path inside DXKeeper, whose interface is English-only. Translating it would describe a menu that does not exist. NOT TRANSLATED: left in English deliberately - either a do-not-translate entry, or the machine pass damaged it and was rejected.

data.name: DxKeeperPortReading
data.comment: EN: (reading from registry…) NOTE: Placeholder shown until DXKeeper's configured port has been read.

" that followed the placeholder, producing "espanolReinicie" and "cestinaObnovit" - two sentences run together. Keep the placeholder at the end.

ErrNotAnIpAddress

data.name: ErrNotMulticast
data.comment: EN: "{0}" is not an IPv4 multicast address (224.0.0.0 - 239.255.255.255) NOTE: Fragment, no full stop. Do not translate the address range or "IPv4".

data.name: MsgBindFailed
data.comment: EN: Could not listen on UDP port {0}: {1} NOTE: Used both as a dialog and as a log line. {0} is a port number, {1} is an operating-system error message.

data.name: AlertMulticastRejected
data.comment: EN: {0} - starting WITHOUT multicast. NOTE: {0} is ErrNotAnIpAddress or ErrNotMulticast. The emphasis on "without" matters: the gateway looks healthy but would receive nothing from that group.

data.name: AlertUdpPortReverted
data.comment: EN: Reverted to UDP port {0}.

data.name: AlertMulticastReverted
data.comment: EN: Reverted the multicast group to "{0}". NOTE: {0} may be empty, meaning no multicast.

data.name: AlertReplaceNoKey
data.value: contactreplace namiesto {0}: žiadne použiteľné <oldcall>/<oldtimestamp> - úprava nebola aplikovaná na DXKeeper
data.comment: EN: contactreplace for {0}: no usable <oldcall>/<oldtimestamp> - the edit was NOT applied to DXKeeper NOTE: "contactreplace", "<oldcall>" and "<oldtimestamp>" are wire-format names - do not translate them. {0} is a callsign.

data.name: AlertDeleteNoKey
data.value: contactdelete namiesto {0}: chýbajúci volací znak alebo časová pečiatka - nič nebolo zaslané DXKeeper
data.comment: EN: contactdelete for {0}: missing callsign or timestamp - nothing was sent to DXKeeper NOTE: "contactdelete" is a wire-format name - do not translate it. {0} is a callsign.

data.name: AlertInternalError
data.value: VNÚTORNÝ ERROR rieši správu. {0}: {1} Pozri ErrorLog.txt Brána stále beží.
data.comment: EN: INTERNAL ERROR handling a message. {0}: {1}. See ErrorLog.txt. The gateway is still running. NOTE: A defect in this program, not bad input. {0} is an exception type name and {1} its message - do not translate either. The last sentence matters: it tells the operator not to restart mid-contest. REVIEW: the machine pass ran a product name into the next word and a space was inserted to separate them. Check that the wording around it reads naturally.

data.name: AlertInvalidMessage
AlertReplaceLostQso
data.value: *** {0}: DXKeeper Vymazaný originál, ale neprihlásil editáciu{1} - editovaný QSO je {2}, importovať. Dôvod: {3}
data.comment: EN: *** {0}: DXKeeper DELETED the original but did not log the edit{1} - the edited QSO is in {2}, import it. Reason: {3} NOTE: The most serious message this program emits: DXKeeper no longer holds the QSO at all. Keep the *** marker. {0} callsign, {1} an optional " (TCP 52001)" tag, {2} a filename, {3} a reason from the Fail* strings.

data.name: AlertReplaceLostQsoNotSaved
data.value: *** {0}: DXKeeper Vymazaný originál, úprava nebola prihlásená{1}, A úprava nemohla byť uložená {2} Dôvod: {3}

data.name: AlertNotConfirmed
data.comment: EN: DXKeeper did not confirm {0}{1}{2}: {3} NOTE: {0} a short description of the QSO, {1} an optional " (TCP 52001)" tag, {2} AlertSavedTo or AlertNotSavedTo or empty, {3} a reason from the Fail* strings.

data.name: AlertSavedTo
data.comment: EN: - saved to {0} NOTE: Fragment appended inside AlertNotConfirmed. Keep the leading space. {0} is a filename.

data.name: AlertNotSavedTo
data.comment: EN: - AND it could not be saved to {0} NOTE: Fragment appended inside AlertNotConfirmed. Keep the leading space. {0} is a filename.

data.name: FailBusy
data.comment: EN: another send had not finished yet NOTE: Deliberately plain. This read "another send was already in flight" and machine-translated into German as a literal statement about aviation - see the note on idioms at the top of this file.

data.name: FailConnectTimeout
data.value: spojenie s DXKeeper časované po {0} sekundy
data.comment: EN: the connection to DXKeeper timed out after {0} seconds NOTE: {0} is a number of seconds.

data.name: FailConnectRefused
data.value: nemožno pripojiť k DXKeeper o TCP prístav {0}; DXKeeper, skontroluj {1} "Listening"
data.comment: EN: cannot connect to DXKeeper on TCP port {0}; in DXKeeper, check that {1} reports "Listening" NOTE: {0} is a port number. {1} is DxKeeperConfigNetworkService, an English menu path inside DXKeeper - it must stay untranslated because DXKeeper's own interface is English-only.

data.name: FailNoPeerClose
data.value: DXKeeper nikdy neuzavreli spojenie {0} sekundy, takže QSO možno nikdy neboli prijaté
data.comment: EN: DXKeeper never closed the connection within {0} seconds, so the QSO may never have been accepted NOTE: {0} is a number of seconds. DXKeeper acknowledges only by closing the connection, so no close means the QSO cannot be claimed as delivered.

data.name: FailShuttingDown
data.value: Brána bola vypnutá a toto nikdy nebolo poslané.
data.comment: EN: the gateway was shutting down and this was never sent

data.name: FailSendFailed
data.comment: EN: the send failed NOTE: Last-resort wording when no more specific reason is available.

data.name: TranslatedBy
data.comment: EN: Tom Schaefer, NY4I NOTE: WHOEVER TRANSLATED THIS FILE: replace this value with your name and callsign, however you would like to be credited. It is shown in the About window to anyone running the gateway in this language, and it is the one entry here that is not a translation of the English. Free-form - a name, a callsign, an email, a club, whatever you prefer. It is never overwritten by the machine-translation tool.

data.name: AboutLink
data.comment: EN: About NOTE: Small link in the window footer that opens the About window.

data.name: AboutTitle
data.comment: EN: About N1MM-DXKeeper Gateway NOTE: Title of the About window. The product name stays in English.

data.name: AboutVersion
data.comment: EN: Version {0} NOTE: {0} is a version number such as 2.0.0.

data.name: AboutPurpose
data.value: Carries QSOs z TR4W a N1MM Logger+ do DXKeeper, a pýta sa DXView a Pathfinder o volaní, ktoré pracuješ.
data.comment: EN: Carries QSOs from TR4W and N1MM Logger+ into DXKeeper, and asks DXView and Pathfinder about the callsigns you work. NOTE: One-line description. All five product names stay in English. TR4W is named here and nowhere else - the program's title stays "N1MM-DXKeeper Gateway", which is what operators have called it for years.

data.name: AboutTranslationBy
data.comment: EN: Translation into {0} by {1} NOTE: {0} is a language name in its own language, {1} is the value of TranslatedBy. Do not translate either.

data.comment: EN: A rewrite of the original VB6 gateway. The DXLab Suite message formats are the work of AA6YQ. NOTE: "VB6", "DXLab Suite" and the callsign AA6YQ stay in English.

data.name: AboutClose

data.name: AboutProfileCopied
data.comment: EN: Details copied to the clipboard.

data.name: NoticeTitle
data.comment: EN: About this program NOTE: Title of the first-run notice window. Deliberately not "Licence Agreement" - nothing is being agreed to.

data.name: NoticeHeading
data.comment: EN: Free software, and no warranty

data.name: NoticeFreeSoftware
data.value: N1MM-DXKeeper Gateway je bezplatný softvér pod GNU General Public License, verzia 3 alebo neskôr. Môžete ju používať na akýkoľvek účel, študovať, ako funguje, deliť sa o ňu a meniť ju.
data.comment: EN: N1MM-DXKeeper Gateway is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. You may use it for any purpose, study how it works, share it, and change it. NOTE: "GNU General Public License" is the name of a licence - do not translate it.

data.name: NoticeWarranty
data.value: Prichádza s ASOLUTENE NO WARRANTY. Ponúka sa v nádeji, že je užitočná, ale nikto nezaručuje, že je vhodná na nejaký konkrétny účel, a žiadny prispievateľ nie je zodpovedný za všetko, čo sa pokazí. Váš denník je vaša zodpovednosť: skontrolujte, či QSOs dosah DXKeeper.
data.comment: EN: It comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY. It is offered in the hope that it is useful, but nobody guarantees it is fit for any particular purpose, and no contributor is liable for anything that goes wrong. Your log is your responsibility: check that QSOs reach DXKeeper. NOTE: The point of this window. Keep the emphasis on "no warranty" - many languages capitalise for emphasis differently, so use whatever reads as emphatic. The last sentence is specific to this program: the operator's contest log is at stake.

data.name: NoticeWhereToFind
data.value: Plná licencia je v súbore COPIEING.txt vedľa programu a je vždy k dispozícii z odkazu About v okne.
data.comment: EN: The full licence is in the file COPYING.txt next to the program, and is always available from the About link in the window. NOTE: "COPYING.txt" is a filename - do not translate it.

data.name: NoticeViewLicence
data.comment: EN: View the licence NOTE: Button that opens the COPYING file.

data.name: NoticeUnderstood
data.comment: EN: I understand NOTE: Button that dismisses the notice. An acknowledgement, not an acceptance - see the note above.

data.name: DlgCouldNotOpenLicence
DlgLicenceMissing
TrayShow
data.comment: EN: Open the gateway window NOTE: Notification area menu entry that brings the window back. Also the double-click action. Phrased as a full instruction rather than "Show gateway", which machine-translated into German as "Schaufenster" (a shop window) - a bare verb-noun pair gives a translator nothing to disambiguate against.

data.name: TrayQuit
data.comment: EN: Quit the gateway NOTE: Notification area menu entry that shuts the gateway down. Not the bare word "Quit", which machine-translated into German as "Quittung" (a receipt), Japanese as "login" and Korean as nonsense. Naming the object gives the model something to work with.

data.name: TrayHiddenTitle
data.comment: EN: Still running NOTE: Title of the notification shown the first time the window is minimised to the notification area.

data.name: TrayHiddenMessage
data.value: Brána stále prijíma QSOs Tu. Kliknutím na túto ikonu vrátite okno späť.
data.comment: EN: The gateway is still receiving QSOs here. Double-click this icon to bring the window back. NOTE: Shown once per session. It matters: an operator who thinks they closed the gateway would stop watching for problems while it is still the only thing logging their contest.

data.name: TrayReceived
data.comment: EN: Received from N1MM: {0} NOTE: Count of UDP datagrams received. Menu entry.

data.name: TrayLogged
data.comment: EN: Logged to DXKeeper: {0} NOTE: Count of QSOs DXKeeper confirmed. Menu entry.

data.name: TrayQueued
data.comment: EN: Waiting to send: {0} NOTE: Count of QSOs queued behind the one in flight. Menu entry.

data.name: TrayNotDelivered
data.comment: EN: NOT delivered: {0} NOTE: Count of QSOs DXKeeper did not confirm. Menu entry. The emphasis is deliberate - this is the number that needs acting on.

data.name: TrayAllDelivered
data.comment: EN: All QSOs delivered NOTE: Menu entry shown instead of TrayNotDelivered when nothing has failed.

data.name: TrayLastQso
data.comment: EN: Last QSO: {0} NOTE: {0} is a callsign and time, e.g. "W1AW 14:32". Menu entry.

data.name: TrayNoQsoYet
data.comment: EN: No QSOs yet

data.name: TrayOpenFailedFile
data.comment: EN: Open the undelivered QSO file NOTE: Menu entry that opens FailedQSOs_*.adi.

data.name: TrayOpenFailedFolder
data.comment: EN: Show it in its folder NOTE: Menu entry that opens Explorer with the undelivered-QSO file selected. Needed as well as the entry above because .adi often has no program associated with it, and because the file may not be in the Gateway's own folder.

data.name: TrayFailureTitle
data.comment: EN: QSO not delivered NOTE: Title of the notification raised when DXKeeper does not confirm a QSO while the window is hidden.

data.name: TrayTooltip
data.comment: EN: Received {0}, logged {1}, not delivered {2} NOTE: Tooltip under the product name. Windows caps the whole tooltip at 127 characters and it is truncated past that, so keep this short.

data.comment: EN: Config > Defaults tab > Network Service NOTE: DO NOT TRANSLATE. A literal menu path inside DXKeeper, whose interface is English-only. NOT TRANSLATED: left in English deliberately - either a do-not-translate entry, or the machine pass damaged it and was rejected.
